title: Retriever
description: The desired recipe set for one network zone: which recipes, at which versions (exact or constraint), from which cookbook. Consumed by transfer tools in passthrough mode (periodic re-resolution) or mirror mode (per-synchronization resolution). See RECIPE-SPEC.md for normative semantics.

apiVersion.description: Schema version of this document. The only value accepted by this schema revision is 'recipe.tobby.dev/v1alpha1'.

kind.description: Document kind. Always 'Retriever' for this schema.

metadata.description: Identity and metadata of the retriever. There is no 'version' field: a retriever is living configuration tracked in version control, not a published versioned artifact.

name.description: Retriever name; conventionally the name of the zone it describes (lowercase alphanumerics with '.', '_', '-' separators).

description.description: Human-readable description of the zone and its purpose (at most 2048 characters).

labels.description: Identifying key/value pairs intended for selection and filtering (Kubernetes label syntax; values at most 63 characters).

annotations.description: Non-identifying metadata. Keys should be namespaced with a DNS prefix. Keys under 'recipe.tobby.dev/' are reserved by the specification. Values are at most 4096 characters.

cookbook.description: Default cookbook to resolve recipes from: '<registry-host>[:<port>]/<repository-path>'. No scheme, no credentials; the hostname is the key for out-of-band credential lookup (kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson format).

recipes.description: Recipes desired in this zone. Each entry resolves independently against its cookbook's tags; the recipe artifact and all its ingredients are transferred.

recipeSelector.description: Selection of one recipe (by name) at an exact version or the highest version matching a constraint.

name.description: Recipe name as published in the cookbook (matches the recipe's metadata.name and the repository's last path segment).

version.description: Exact recipe version, or version constraint expression (wildcards '16.x', caret '^1.4.0', tilde '~1.4.2', comparisons '>=2.0.0', conjunctions '>=2.0.0 <3.0.0'), resolved against the cookbook's tags for that recipe.

cookbook.description: Optional per-entry override of spec.cookbook, with the same syntax rules.
